children: DALLAS, Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RMX Industries, Inc. ("RMX" or the "Company") (OTCQB: RMXI), an edge intelligence company delivering QuantrusX™, today announced it has signed a compute supply purchase order with Technologent for NVIDIA H200 GPU systems that will power QuantrusX™ deployments.

This order is expected to establish a dedicated supply line for high-performance GPU compute as RMX scales Real-World Intelligence (RWI) deployments across a growing base of customers and operational environments. RWI is the company's name for intelligence built at the physical edge.
"Compute is the foundation every intelligence deployment stands on," said Karl Kit, CEO of RMX. "This order puts proven NVIDIA H200 infrastructure behind QuantrusX™ as we scale."

Technologent is a women-owned WBENC-certified and global provider of Information Technology solutions and services for Fortune 1000 companies. Technologent powers businesses through a combination of foundational IT disciplines: Data, Artificial Intelligence, Security and Cloud. For more information visit

RMX Industries, Inc. (OTCQB: RMXI) is an edge intelligence company building physical-edge intelligence solutions for operational and mission-critical environments, drawing on a legacy in video optimization and data transfer technology. RMX is focused on platforms, such as its proprietary edge intelligence platform, QuantrusX™, that bring intelligence closer to the real world, supporting faster data interpretation, local response, and trusted decision-making where connectivity, time, and context matter.
